children: Apple (AAPL) Q3 revenue $109.4B, up 16% YoY. Record iPhone, Mac and Services sales; record active installed base. AI concerns were noted alongside results.
AAPL opened preorders Oct 16 for the iPhone Duo, deliveries Oct 23, 2026. Pricing starts at $1,999 (256GB), up to 2TB. Counterpoint projects ~6M 2026 shipments.
Analysts bullish on Apple (AAPL) expect iPhone revenue to rise; some say fiscal 2027 iPhone forecasts may be low and predict material sales from a higher‑priced Duo model upon launch.
Apple (AAPL) will unveil smart‑home hardware and related offerings on Oct. 13 under new CEO John Ternus, signaling the company’s planned push into the smart‑home market.
Apple deployed an upgraded on-device Siri AI to users, offering more personalized, context-aware responses compared with prior Siri. Rollout completed after earlier delays.
Apple (AAPL) plans HomePod mini and Apple TV hardware refreshes—the first HomePod mini update since 2020 and first Apple TV update since 2022; full-size HomePod updates also possible.
Bank of America warns Apple (AAPL) may trail rivals on AI agents; Siri could lag in converting user intent into transactions, potentially hurting Apple’s ecosystem monetization.
AAPL: iPhone 18 Pro saw 12% YoY unit growth in China in first three days; iPhone Pro series held 33% smartphone market share in China during Week 38 — boosting product mix and revenue potential
Meta's Muse AI may let users buy in-app without app stores, potentially cutting purchases routed through Apple's App Store and pressuring AAPL's services revenue from commissions.
Apple Pay launched in India Sept 30 via Axis Bank partnership; eligible Axis Visa and Mastercard cards can be added to Apple Wallet for NFC, in-app and web payments; Mac support later; no UPI/RuPay.
